programs.title: I Know What You Did Last Summer
programs.desc: Southport, a fishing community in North Carolina.Four friends - Helen, her boyfriend Barry, Julie and Ray - are driving home from celebrating the Fourth of July.Suddenly, a figure in a fisherman's cape appears on the road.Barry, who is under the influence of alcohol, hits the brake too late.The young people decide not to notify the police about the accident and throw the body into the water.Their plans are not changed even by the fact that the victim shows faint signs of life.After returning home, they cannot recover.Julie becomes depressed.A year after the tragic events, the girl receives a blood-curdling anonymous letter.It reads: "I know what you did last summer."Soon the nightmare begins.A box office hit of horror cinema, which turned out to be a career ticket for the actors playing the main roles.A slasher based on the 1973 novel, written by Kevin Williamson, who proved his ability to scare by writing the script for "Scream".

programs.title: Widow Clicquot
programs.desc: France at the turn of the 18th and 19th centuries.Twenty-year-old Barbe-Nicole Ponsardin (Haley Bennett) becomes the wife of François Clicquot (Tom Sturridge), a descendant of a family of winemakers.Although the marriage was arranged, they share great love.They also run a business together, and the woman is fascinated by her beloved's avant-garde approach to the methods of producing alcohol.Unfortunately, their happiness is disturbed by the man's sudden death.Despite the pain of losing her loved one, 27-year-old Barbe-Nicole, mother of Clémentine (Cecily Cleeve), is determined to manage the vineyard as a single woman, contrary to custom.She wants to continue implementing her husband's modern theories on viticulture and bottling techniques, and prepare her own blend of sparkling wine.To win, she must not be defeated by the capricious weather that threatens her harvest, the ruthless Jean-Remy Moët (Nicholas Farrell) who wants to deprive her of her business, or even the state that has the Napoleonic Code, which prohibits women from running a business.Based on the true story of a woman called the "grand lady of Champagne", who created the famous Veuve Clicquot brand and was one of the first businesswomen in the world.

programs.title: Christmas In The Spotlight
programs.desc: The singer and the football player start dating before Christmas.The public is following the development of their relationship with interest.The couple must decide whether the affair will turn into a lasting relationship.

programs.title: All That Breathes
programs.desc: The brothers Nadeem and Saud live in one of the most densely populated cities in the world - New Delhi.They both devoted themselves to protecting a species of bird characteristic of the local ecosystem - the black kite.These majestic predators descend on city streets in large numbers due to the very high level of air pollution.Nadeem and Saud spend their days and nights washing and treating the birds in their makeshift hospital located in the basement.After recovery, they help the black kites return to their natural habitat.The painting was awarded, among others:at the Sundance and Cannes festivals and nominated for an Oscar.

programs.title: Barry 2
programs.desc: Further adventures of Barry Berkman, a former Marine and murderer who discovers his passion for acting.He is faced with the consequences of his previous decisions, including:murder of a friend.
